services.name: Bonita Boat Rentals
services.desc: Nothing beats relaxing on the soft sands of Florida’s southwest coast beaches more than cruising the crystal blue-green waters of Estero Bay in a boat rented from Bonita Boat Rentals. Estero Bay continues to overflow with abundant marine life as it did when it was officially named Florida’s first aquatic preserve in 1966. Tourists and residents alike appreciate everything the waters have to offer, from watching marine life to plentiful fishing. Estero Bay is the perfect place to be when you want a fulfilling experience on the water and Bonita Boat Rentals in Bonita Springs, FL can get you there. services.name: Seeing dolphins
services.desc: I’ve often been asked by people renting a boat and keen on doing some wildlife sightseeing, “Will we see any manatees?” And then, almost invariably, they respond with a follow up, “Well, where would they be exactly? Is there anywhere we can go to see them?” At which point I often just shrug my shoulder and kind of wish them good luck, because the truth of the matter is that there really is no particular place I can point to on a map and say, “Thar be manatees matey!” But what I can do is offer some general advice on where you might be most likely to spot a manatee in and around Estero Bay, as well as what you should and should not do upon encountering them. services.name: rent fishing rods
services.desc: At Bonita Boat Rentals, we make rod rentals available to our boat renters for just $15 with a fully stocked tackle box. If you’re looking for bait, boat renters can purchase frozen bait shrimp for $5 per 8 oz. bag. Not sure what you’ll need? We’re happy to help. We recommend using light tackle and bait shrimp when fishing out on the bay. Our convenient location allows our renters quick and easy access to some of the best fishing spots in southwest Florida. Estero Bay is only minutes away. Big Hickory Bay, the Imperial River and Fish Trap Bay are also very close. Spanning 15 square miles, Estero Bay is an inshore angler’s paradise.
